# inkwell

> A local-first markdown editor for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Notes are stored as plain .md files in a folder you choose — no account required and no telemetry. Vaults stay on your device unless you choose to share one for real-time collaboration.

inkwell is free and open source, built with Tauri, React, and Rust.

Key features: live split-view markdown preview, ten built-in themes, a full drawing canvas (flowcharts, mind maps, sequence diagrams), Kanban boards, GitHub sync for notes, a Claude MCP server for reading/writing the vault from Claude, a global Quick Note capture window, a weekly planner with tagged tasks, and opt-in real-time collaboration on shared vaults (owner, editor and viewer roles; offline edits merge on reconnect).

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://inkwell-lp.vercel.app/): overview, features, and download links for macOS, Windows, and Linux
- [Documentation](https://inkwell-lp.vercel.app/docs): install instructions per platform, editor and canvas usage, themes, export, sharing and collaboration, GitHub sync, Claude MCP setup, and keyboard shortcuts
- [Privacy](https://inkwell-lp.vercel.app/privacy): what the app collects (nothing, unless you share a vault) and what the website collects (anonymous page-view analytics)
